name: marketing-headers
title: Header
description: Top navigation bars for marketing websites, combining logo branding, navigation links, and CTA buttons in left-links, centered-links, right-links, and authenticated user-dropdown layouts.
useWhen: Providing top-level navigation for a marketing website, landing page, or product site.
Combining a logo, navigation links, and sign-in / sign-up CTAs in a single persistent top bar.
Adding a user-account dropdown for authenticated states in a marketing site that also has an app.
avoidWhen: Building navigation for a web application — use a side-menu or application breadcrumb pattern instead.
The page is a focused landing page where navigation would distract from the conversion goal.
Mobile navigation requires a mega-menu — these variants use a simple link row that collapses to a hamburger.
responsiveBehavior: Navigation links collapse to a hamburger menu on mobile. CTAs remain visible as icon-only buttons or inside the mobile drawer. Logo stays in the top-left at all viewports.
accessibility: Wrap the header in a <header> element with role='banner' for the primary site header landmark.
The navigation links must be in a <nav> element with aria-label='Main navigation'.
The mobile hamburger toggle must have aria-expanded reflecting the drawer state and aria-controls pointing to the menu id.

variants.title: Icon and links on the left, call to actions on the right
variants.description: Logo and navigation links grouped on the left, with sign-in and sign-up CTA buttons on the right — the most common SaaS marketing header layout.
accessibility: Logo image alt names the company; nav links are in <nav aria-label='Main navigation'>; CTA buttons have descriptive labels.

variants.title: Icon and links on the left, call to actions on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Left-logo-and-links marketing header adapted for dark website surfaces.
accessibility: Logo, navigation links, and CTA buttons must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark header backgrounds.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links in the middle and call to actions on the right
variants.description: Three-zone header with logo on the far left, navigation links centered, and sign-in / CTA buttons on the far right — the classic horizontal-centered nav layout.
accessibility: Centered nav links are inside <nav>; logo alt names the company; mobile hamburger uses aria-expanded.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links in the middle and call to actions on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Three-zone marketing header adapted for dark website surfaces.
accessibility: All three zones — logo, nav links, and CTA buttons — must meet contrast requirements on dark header backgrounds.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links and call to actions on the right
variants.description: Logo on the left with navigation links and CTA buttons grouped together on the right — a compact layout for sites with fewer nav items.
accessibility: Logo alt names the company; right-side links and buttons are in a <nav>; all items have descriptive labels.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links and call to actions on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Logo-left-links-right compact marketing header adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Navigation links and CTA buttons on the right must meet contrast requirements on dark header backgrounds.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links and user dropdown on the right
variants.description: Authenticated header with logo, navigation links, and a user-avatar dropdown for account settings, profile, and sign-out — for marketing sites that also have an application.
accessibility: User avatar button must have aria-expanded and aria-haspopup='true'; dropdown menu uses role='menu' with role='menuitem' items.

variants.title: Icon on the left, links and user dropdown on the right (Dark)
variants.description: Authenticated user-dropdown marketing header adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: User avatar and dropdown menu items must meet contrast requirements on dark header and dropdown backgrounds.
